item.title: Dhaka’s air quality 2nd worst in the world this morning

item.description: Saudi Arabia has rolled out comprehensive guidelines to preserve safety, security, and smooth movement of Umrah performers during Ramadan 1447AH, as visitor numbers surge at the Grand Mosque in Makkah.The measures form part of an operational plan to regulate crowds, enhance emergency readiness, and ensure pilgrims perform rituals in a calm and organised environment.Managing peak crowdsRamadan attracts millions of worshippers, particularly during the last ten nights. item.title: Selima Rahman hospitalised after cardiac arrest
item.description: BNP Standing Committee Member Begum Selima Rahman has been admitted to United Hospital in the capital after she suffered cardiac arrest.Currently, she is receiving treatment at the CCU of the hospital, the party's media cell member Shayrul Kabir Khan confirmed.He added, Selima Rahman suffered cardiac arrest around 10PM on February 19. Later she was admitted to theUnited Hospital.Family members and the party have requested prayers from the countrymen for her recovery.

item.title: 4 get life imprisonment for Kamrangirchar gang rape
item.description: A Dhaka tribunal has sentenced four individuals to life imprisonment for the gang rape of a 25-year-old woman in the capital's Kamrangirchar area.The convicts are Shahidul Islam, 23, Saifull Islam, 25, Nizam, 24, and Monir Hossain alias Sentu, 26.Judge Munshi Md Moshiyar Rahman of the Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal-4 pronounced the verdict on Sunday morning (22 February).In addition to the life sentences, the court imposed a fine of Tk1 lakh on each convict. item.title: BCB mourns death of Mahedi Hasan’s mother
item.description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Sunday expressed deep sorrow at the death of Momtaz Begum, the mother of Bangladesh national cricketer Shak Mahedi Hasan, who passed away in Khulna.In an official condolence message, the BCB said it was “deeply bereaved” by the loss and conveyed heartfelt sympathies to the 31-years-old's family.The BCB also offered prayers for the eternal peace of the departed soul, describing the loss as a moment of sorrow for the all-rounder.
